resolution: All 5 HIGH + 6 MEDIUM findings fixed and verified (idempotency indexes, file_path-scoped upsert, sound pure-fns, Go panic/soundness, hard-fail on malformed NDJSON, valid JSON emit, fixed migration probes). Bonus: fixed dead HashTbl/ArrayElem/BytesBuf detection (member_of suffix match) and stale selftest invocation. dune test 35/35 + selftests green. Merged to main as bfbb59f. FOLLOW-UP: callgraph<->effects canonical-name reconciliation so transitive effects-of works across the two OCaml producers (pre-existing, out of scope).
scope: git diff main...HEAD (40 files, ~4318 insertions) — full Phase-1 effects + Phase-2 capability layer

findings.summary: attack_edges INSERT OR IGNORE cannot dedup — no UNIQUE constraint exists; re-loading a sidecar silently doubles every edge (verified empirically: 12 rows / 6 distinct after double-load).
findings.evidence: capability_db.ml:257 INSERT OR IGNORE; capabilities-schema-migration.sql:85 attack_edges has only id PRIMARY KEY, no UNIQUE(from_action,to_action,edge_type).
findings.fix: Add UNIQUE index over (from_action, from_path, to_action, to_path, edge_type) using COALESCE for NULLs.

findings.summary: write_effects plain INSERT, no dedup key; re-running arch-effects-load duplicates all effect rows, contradicting the migration's 'Safe to re-run' header.
findings.fix: Delete rows for incoming producer before insert, or UNIQUE key + INSERT OR IGNORE/upsert.

findings.summary: Capability upsert keys on function_name only; a sidecar for one duplicate function name updates ALL rows with that name across components/languages.
findings.evidence: capability_db.ml:126 fn_exists + :172 UPDATE ... WHERE function_name = ?; file_path is ignored even when present.
findings.fix: When cap_file_path is present, match on (function_name, file_path).

findings.summary: pure-fns excludes only is_direct=1 effect rows; a function with no direct effect that transitively calls a mutator is reported pure — unsound in a tool sold on soundness.
findings.evidence: arch-query:269 WHERE f.name NOT IN (SELECT function_name FROM function_effects WHERE is_direct=1) — no reachability closure over MUST/MAY_ENUMERATED.
findings.fix: Exclude any function whose MUST/MAY_ENUMERATED closure intersects a direct effect, or rename/document as direct-purity only.

findings.summary: Header claims 'Safe to re-run: uses ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS' but the DDL is bare ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN; documented raw re-run (sqlite3 db < migration.sql) fails on duplicate column.
findings.evidence: capabilities-schema-migration.sql:6 & :16 claim IF NOT EXISTS; actual lines (reachability_class/actor_role/... ADD COLUMN) omit it.
findings.fix: Either add IF NOT EXISTS (SQLite>=3.37) or fix the header to state re-run must go through arch-sidecar-load's guarded migrator.

findings.summary: For a sidecar function with no existing effects row, write_capabilities inserts a fabricated value_kind='UnknownMut' row (is_direct defaults 1) — making non-mutating actions appear as mutators and dropping them from pure-fns.
findings.evidence: capability_db.ml:173-178 VALUES (?, 'UnknownMut', 'manual', ...); guard table effects_db.ml:114 is_direct DEFAULT 1.
findings.fix: Store capability attributes in a dedicated table, or mark synthetic rows (is_direct=0 / distinct producer) and exclude from mutator/purity queries.

findings.summary: Panic in ssautil.AllFunctions is recovered into an empty function set; extractor exits 0 with zero effects (false-confidence: DB looks fully analyzed).
findings.fix: Fall back to walking package members, or exit non-zero when AllFunctions panics and no effects were extracted.

findings.summary: Emits Soundness='sound' unconditionally even when packages.Load reported per-package errors → under-approximated set labeled sound.
findings.evidence: main.go:282 collects p.Errors as warnings only; :338 always Soundness:'sound'.
findings.fix: Downgrade to 'candidate' (or exit non-zero) when any package reported errors.

findings.summary: Malformed NDJSON records silently skipped, loader still returns Ok — partial/empty loads look successful (unlike arch_load's Empty_calls guard).
findings.evidence: effects_load.ml:67 | exception Failure _ -> incr n_skipped; returns Ok regardless.
findings.fix: Return Error by default when records were skipped; add explicit --allow-skip for lossy imports.

findings.summary: emit_json uses OCaml %S which escapes bytes>127 as decimal \ddd — invalid JSON; effects_load then silently drops such records.
findings.evidence: arch_effects_ocaml.ml:33-40 %S for names; effects_load.ml:67 drops unparseable line.
findings.fix: Encode with Yojson (`String s) rather than %S.

findings.summary: Auto-migration probe uses Sqlite3.exec which returns OK on zero rows, so a missing Phase-2 column is read as present and migration is skipped (masked today only by write_capabilities' ensure_column fallback).
findings.evidence: main.ml:21-24 match Sqlite3.exec ... with OK -> true.
findings.fix: Use exec_no_headers with a callback flag (as capability_db.ml already does).

findings.summary: UPDATE ... WHERE function_name=? writes capability attrs to every value_kind row of a function and counts each in n_updated (misleading counts + fan-out).
findings.evidence: capability_db.ml:163-172; views GROUP BY function_name to compensate.
findings.fix: Store capability attributes once per function in a dedicated table.

findings.summary: ensure_table_column swallows ALL ALTER failures; a genuine failure surfaces later only as a silently skipped record.
findings.fix: Ignore only 'duplicate column name'; propagate other errors.

findings.summary: scan_files_with_ext wraps the whole Array.iter in one try/with, so a Sys.is_directory exception on one broken symlink aborts scanning of all remaining siblings.
findings.evidence: walk body: try readdir; Array.iter(... Sys.is_directory ...) with _ -> ().
findings.fix: Wrap per-entry logic in its own try/with.

findings.summary: selftest-effects.sh (345 lines, new this branch) and the callgraph selftests are not run in CI; no selftest loads the shipped sidecar format.
findings.evidence: ci.yml:26-28 runs only selftest-contract.sh and selftest-load.sh.
findings.fix: Add selftest-effects.sh (and callgraph selftests) to the CI shell-tests step.

cross_runtime_findings.summary: fan-in interpolates raw $1 into sqlite3 SQL (LIMIT ${1:-25}) enabling multi-statement injection into the local DB. PRE-EXISTING on main (not introduced by this branch).
cross_runtime_findings.evidence: arch-query:134 LIMIT ${1:-25}; $1 is not the quote-stripped $A/$B.
cross_runtime_findings.fix: Validate the limit against ^[0-9]+$ before interpolation.

note: Branch builds and passes its own tests, but tests do not exercise re-load idempotency, cross-component sidecars, or purity-vs-capability interaction — which is why HIGH correctness issues slipped through. All HIGH findings are branch-introduced except the pre-existing fan-in injection.
